{"id":1822798500,"question_id":3863,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1762463516,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1822798500/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Power Grid Maintenance","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> processQueries(int c, vector<vector<int>>& connections, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        int n = queries.size();\n        vector<int>ans;\n        unordered_map<int,int>grid;\n        unordered_map<int,bool>station;\n\n        for(int i =1 ; i<=c ; i++) station[i] = true;\n\n        for(auto pairs : connections)\n        {\n            grid[pairs[0]] = pairs[1];\n        }\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(auto query : queries)\n        {\n            if(query[0] == 1 and station[query[1]] == true)\n            {\n                count++;\n                ans.push_back(query[1]);\n            }\n            else if(query[0] == 2 and station[query[1]] == true)\n            {\n                station[query[1]] = false;\n            }\n            else if(query[0] == 1 and station[query[1]] == false)\n            {\n                count++;\n                if(grid.find(query[1]) != grid.end())\n                    ans.push_back(grid[query[1]]);\n                else\n                    ans.push_back(-1);\n            }\n            else if(query[0] == 2 and station[query[1]] == false)\n            {\n                ans.push_back(-1);\n            }\n        } \n        ans.resize(count);\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"power-grid-maintenance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1093}
